chapters.1: John introduces Jesus as the Word of life that he and others personally saw and touched, writing so readers can share in genuine fellowship with God. He declares that God is light with no darkness in him, and that walking in that light means honestly confessing sin, which God faithfully forgives and cleanses rather than pretending to be sinless.
chapters.2: John reassures believers that Jesus is their advocate when they sin, and that truly knowing God shows up in obeying his commands, especially the command to love one another. He warns against loving the world's desires instead of God, and alerts readers to "antichrists" who deny that Jesus is the Christ, encouraging believers to remain faithful to what they were taught from the beginning.
chapters.3: John marvels at the love that makes believers children of God and urges them to live righteously while they wait to become fully like Christ at his appearing. He draws a sharp line between the children of God and the children of the devil, centering it on whether a person loves their brothers and sisters, since real love shows itself in action, not just words.
chapters.4: John tells readers to test teachings against the truth that Jesus Christ came in the flesh, rejecting any spirit that denies this. He then unpacks what it means that God is love, explaining that God showed his love by sending his Son, and that since God loved us this way, we are called to love one another, because love and fear of judgment cannot coexist.
chapters.5: John explains that loving God and believing in Jesus as the Son of God go hand in hand with keeping his commandments, and that this faith is what overcomes the world. He describes the testimony God has given about his Son, assures readers that they can know they have eternal life, and that God hears their prayers when they ask according to his will, closing with a final warning to stay away from idols.
